rationale: Several papers provide evidence linking FRBs to magnetars and neutron stars, such as the association of FRB 121102 with a magnetar (1911.12833), frequency drifts in FRBs related to neutron star magnetospheres (1908.07313), and a bright radio burst from a Galactic magnetar (2005.10324). The magnetoionic environments of FRBs are also compared to those of pulsars and magnetars (2009.00790). However, the question is not fully settled as the exact origin and mechanisms remain under investigation.
